title: Ask your meetings anything | Ask Lynkk

lines: Someone said it in a meeting, three weeks ago.
It's in a recording nobody rewatches, or in notes spread across different places.
So the same meeting happens twice.
Ask Lynkk answers from your own meeting notes.
What did Acme say about the renewal?
You get the answer with its sources, and it plays the moment it was said.
Ask what's still open, and it lists the open tasks and decisions across your notes.
Then act on it: create a Google Calendar event or a Jira issue.
Stop searching your meetings. Ask them.
Ask Lynkk is part of Lynkk Pro. Start free at lynkk.ai.
